verdict.rationale: Together AI documents an official CLI. Fine-tuning jobs can be launched 'with the CLI', and the dedicated-endpoints docs show a concrete `tg beta endpoints deploy ...` command, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence is two brief mentions, and the endpoints commands sit under a `beta` namespace. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI reference documentation, evidence of agent-friendly features (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), coverage of the CLI beyond fine-tuning and endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
